respondents: Directing respondents 1 to 6 collectively to convert the excess land held by the 7th respondent under i) survey No. 1104/1, measuring 20 × 2 feet, ii) survey No. 1104/4B, measuring 114 × 2 feet as public road along with the existing AA panchayath road, in addition to the Gift settlement deed bearing Document No. 2018/2028 dated 21.06.2018

judgment_text:
PRAYER

ORDER

This writ petition has been filed to direct the respondents 1 to 6 to remove the encroachment made by the 7th respondent over the lands morefully described in the prayer to this writ petition, which were already gifted to the Panchayat by the 7th respondent based on the Gift Settlement Deed bearing Document No. 2018/2018 dated 21-6-2018.

2. The petitioner claims that the 7th respondent having already gifted the lands morefully described in the prayer of this writ petition in favour of the Panchayat, through the aforesaid gift deed dated 21-6-2018, has now illegally encroached a portion of the said land thereby blocking the public road.

3. The petitioner had given a representation on 31-1-2026 to the official respondents requesting them to remove the alleged encroachment made by the 7th respondent. Since the said representation has not been considered till date, the petitioner has filed this writ petition.

4. Mr N. Muthuvel, learned government advocate accepts notice on behalf of respondents 2 and 5. Mr N. Naveen Kumar, learned government advocate accepts notice on behalf of respondents 1, 3, 4 and 6.

5. This Court is not expressing any opinion on the merits of the petitioner's representation.

6. No prejudice would be caused to the respondents if the petitioner's representation as stated supra is considered on merits and in accordance with law, after hearing the objections of the 7th respondent and any other third party whom the second respondent deems fit to enquire within a time frame to be fixed by this Court.

7. The second respondent is the competent authority to adjudicate the petitioner's representation.

8. For the foregoing reasons, this writ petition is disposed of by directing the second respondent to pass final orders on merits and in accordance with law on the petitioner's representation dated 31-1-2026, seeking for removal of the alleged encroachment made by the 7th respondent over the property morefully described in the prayer to this writ petition, which according to the petitioner was already gifted by the 7th respondent to the Panchayat under the Gift Settlement Deed bearing Document No. 2018/2018 dated 21-6-2018 after hearing the objections of the 7th respondent and any other third party whom the second respondent deems fit to enquire, within a period of four months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. No Costs. Consequently, W.M.P. No. 8873 of 2026 is ordered subject to payment of separate Court fee and W.M.P. No. 8875 of 2026 is closed.
